page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1.7xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance split between single-core and multi-core operations. Single-core performance is weak, with stress-ng single-core CPU and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25%, and single-threaded gzip compression ranking in the bottom 10%. However, the 32 dedicated physical cores deliver average multi-core performance, as evidenced by middle-50% rankings in stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth remains average across both small and large block reads, though the overall Passmark memory score is weak.

The instance is suited for multi-threaded workloads that can leverage its 32 dedicated cores, such as software compilation, multi-threaded decompression, and static web serving, where it achieves average throughput. It also supports moderate database operations and small-to-medium scale LLM inference prompt processing. However, the lack of local storage and weak single-threaded performance make it less suitable for single-core intensive tasks or applications requiring high-speed local disk I/O.
